survey: A wooden barrel stands upright on a wooden plank floor in front of a flat yellow patterned wall. The camera is a little above the barrel and looks slightly down. The lid is a fairly open ellipse inside a raised rim, and its boards run left to right. Four dark iron hoops wrap the bulging body. Each hoop curves downward like a smile, and the curve gets a little deeper toward the bottom hoop, which is what you expect when you look down at a cylinder. The rivets sit on one vertical center line. The staves are vertical, and the ones near the left and right edges narrow as the body turns away. The barrel's base is a downward-curving ellipse that sits on the floor, with a soft contact shadow. The floor planks run diagonally from lower left to upper right, and the floor's back edge is slightly slanted, so the floor is turned at an angle to the camera. The floor is seen from about the same high angle as the barrel top, so the barrel rests flat on it.
